content: Hey! Let me know if you need help sorting out those concert ticket reimbursements. I have the tally and the payment info handy if you want to check anything.
Yeah, actually, I paid for both mine and Jess's tickets last week through Venmo. Should I send you my transaction ID?
No worries, I pulled up your Venmo payment, looks like you sent $180 to @RiverdaleEvents on March 3rd at 2:48 PM, with 'Concert for Jess + Me' in the note. That's perfect for our records!
Awesome. My Venmo handle is @lisa-holden, just to confirm. And Jess's email is jess.torres88@gmail.com if you need it.

Got it, @lisa-holden matches our payment log, and Jess's email is on the attendee list for Section C, Row 12. Since you covered both tickets, you'll get reimbursed $90 for hers. I'll initiate the PayPal transfer to your email, lisa.holden93@yahoo.com, by 5 PM today for instant processing.
Thanks! Let me know if you need my phone number for the PayPal receipt.

No extra info needed, since your PayPal account ending in 0542 is linked to that email, the payment will clear automatically. You should see the $90 with reference code TRX-4527812 on your PayPal activity by 6 PM latest.
Perfect, I'll keep an eye out. I know sometimes PayPal delays, but I should get a notification soon.
Exactly. If for any reason you don't see the transfer by tonight, just reply with this thread. The TRX-4527812 ID is your proof if PayPal support needs it. Thanks for handling the tickets so quickly!
